subject.title: Architecture: reduce import coupling in pi-embedded-runner/attempt.ts (50+ imports) and discord monitor (30 imports)

question: Should this issue be narrowed to the Discord monitor coupling, with the remaining embedded-runner structural work routed to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/72072?
rationale: The merged embedded-attempt decomposition addresses a substantial part of the original umbrella, but the supplied roadmap does not clearly own the independent Discord preflight/process/provider cleanup.

options.title: Narrow to Discord monitor
options.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical staged Discord monitor boundary cleanup and reference the RuntimePlan RFC for Pi-side work.

options.title: Keep umbrella tracking
options.body: Retain both areas here, accepting overlap with the RuntimePlan RFC while maintainers coordinate the two staged plans.

options.title: Split the remaining scope
options.body: Create or designate a Discord-specific canonical tracker, then leave the Pi-side roadmap exclusively to the RuntimePlan RFC.

recommendation.title: Narrow to Discord monitor
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical staged Discord monitor boundary cleanup and reference the RuntimePlan RFC for Pi-side work.

likelyOwner.reason: They most recently merged the embedded-attempt decomposition and have already reviewed this issue's remaining scope.
